newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Chicago NBD upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Chicago NBD upgrade.

text.p: - McDonald & Co Tuesday upgraded First Chicago NBD Corp to hold from underweight and raised next year's earnings estimate after the bank's third quarter earnings report.

- It was a "a solid albeit by no means superior third-quarter earnings report of $1.12 (operating) versus $1.07 (operating) or some five percent higher," analyst Michael Durante said in a report. Core earnings were nine percent higher, he said.
- Durante raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $4.85 from $4.70 and maintained his 1996 estimate at $4.30 versus 1995's $4.01.
